copy.shield_disclosure: Blocks Windows screen capture of this story. It cannot block a camera pointed at your screen, an external capture device, or a photo of your display.
copy.shield_unavailable: Screenshot shield is unavailable on this system, so this build makes no capture-protection claim here.
copy.receipts_on_viewer: The poster sees a view count, not your name. In a small or individually targeted audience, they may still infer that you viewed. Repeat opens may increase the count.
copy.receipts_off_viewer: The poster records nothing when you open this story. No view is counted and no viewer is named.
